lines.text: Two months ago, I was spending over three hours every single night manually typing WhatsApp receipts and tracking orders for my shop.
Then I enrolled in SkillBridge Academy.
I didn't just learn basic ChatGPT prompts. I learned how to connect OpenAI to WhatsApp and Google Sheets, using n eight n.
Now, when a customer orders at two A M, the system logs the order and sends a Paystack link automatically.
I saved three hours daily, grew my monthly sales, and even started setting up automations for other vendors in my market, for eighty thousand naira per setup.
SkillBridge didn't just teach me tech. It transformed my business.
